prosody_instruction: Speak softly, as if thinking aloud to oneself rather than addressing anyone. Slow pace, drifting cadence, occasional trailing-off at clause ends. Avoid directive intonation. The tone should feel introspective, distracted, almost wandering — like someone remembering, imagining, or recounting to themselves rather than asking a listener for help.

chunks.text: Back in 2025 I was hanging around Shanghai for a couple days and just wandered into a bunch of touristy spots like I was doing my own little attractions crawl.
And earlier that same year I’d taken the high-speed rail from Beijing down to Shanghai — the ride itself was honestly the calmest part of that whole trip.
My coworker also had a work stay in Shenzhen around then, and she kept talking about how hotel-hunting there was way more stressful than she expected.
For Shanghai sightseeing, my cousin Yang Yu had already sorted out tickets for the Oriental Pearl Tower for 2025-03-27.
He picked the morning time slot, and it was for 2 people — he said the views were great but the lines still moved slow.
On the Shenzhen side, my friend Tang Xue stayed at the Grand Hyatt Shenzhen and checked in on 2025-04-22.
She did 3 nights, and meanwhile another friend, Sophia Garcia, had taken train G3 on 2025-04-02 in First Class — she wouldn’t stop bragging about the seat.
